tile.noticesHint: Risk yes, no notice sent · drafts: {drafts} · sent this year: {sent}
tile.noticesHintBare: Open entries with a risk and no notice sent
tile.recallsHintBare: Recalls and withdrawals started, not closed

new.withdrawalNeedsGarments: A withdrawal names what it takes off the market: add a batch number or a serial.

recallKindHint.RECALL: Garments already with end users come back (the public notice asks them).
recallKindHint.WITHDRAWAL: Garments still in the chain (stock, distributors, shops) are taken off the market.

decision.riskHeld: Decide the entry's risk as yes first (Event tab).

decisionHint.NOT_CONFORMING: The PPE does not conform; the authority is told what was done.
decisionHint.RISK: The PPE may present a risk: the authority of each market where it was sold must be told at once.

law.authorityNotice: When the PPE may present a risk, tell the market surveillance authorities of every market where it was sold, with the non-conformity and the corrective action.
law.authorityRequest: On a reasoned request, give the authority every document and piece of information that shows the PPE conforms, in a language it understands.
law.correctiveAction: Take the corrective action needed to bring the PPE into conformity, withdraw it or recall it.
law.distributors: Tell the distributors who received the PPE what was found and what to do.
law.publicNotice: A recall notice to consumers says clearly what is wrong, what to do and whom to contact.

authority.title: Authority notices
authority.failed: The notices and requests could not be read
authority.noticesSub: What was reported to each market surveillance authority, when, and their reference.
authority.noNoticesBody: A notice is needed when the PPE may present a risk; a non-conformity can be told too.
authority.noNoticesRisk: The risk is yes: draft the notice for each market where these garments were sold.
authority.requestsSub: What an authority asked about this product, by when, and the documents sent.
authority.noRequestsBody: Log a request when an authority asks for documents about this style or its batches.

notice.title: Authority notice
notice.newSub: A draft from the entry: product, risk, corrective action. Nothing is sent from here.
notice.nothingSent: Nothing is sent from here: a person submits the notice and records it as sent.
notice.marketHint: The authority of this market is told.
notice.marketCodeHint: The market's code, for example IT or DE.
notice.marketTyped: The markets could not be read: type the market's code (IT, DE …).
notice.authorityHint: The market surveillance authority's name, as it signs its letters.
notice.draftedFrom: The words are drafted from the entry in the market's languages; you can change them before sending.
notice.pdfTab: Open the PDF in a new tab
notice.pdfDraft: The draft as the authority's paper
notice.pdfFailed: The PDF could not be made
notice.pdfStale: The PDF shows the saved words: save the draft to see your changes.
notice.wordsHint: What the authority reads: the product, what was found, the risk, the corrective action.
notice.languageCode: Type a language code of two or three letters (de, fr …).
notice.saveFirst: Save the draft first: the notice is sent as saved.
notice.sendSub: After you submitted it to the authority: the day, their reference and the copy you sent. A fresh code is asked.
notice.referenceHint: The protocol or case number the authority gave.
notice.copyHint: The PDF or the receipt you submitted (optional; it can be added later).
notice.copyNoRight: Adding the copy needs files.upload: it can be added later by someone who has it.
notice.referenceTitle: Add the reference or the copy
notice.referenceNothing: Type the reference or add the copy.
notice.cancelHint: Why it will not be sent.
notice.readFailed: The notice could not be read

problem.market: Choose the market (or type its code, for example IT).
problem.authorityLong: The authority's name is too long (300 characters at most).
problem.riskNotDecided: A notice of risk needs the entry's risk decided as yes first.
problem.noWords: The notice needs its words in at least one language.
problem.emptyWords: A language has no words: write them or remove the language.
problem.wordsLong: The words are too long (20,000 characters at most per language).
problem.sentFuture: The day it was sent cannot be in the future.
problem.sentBeforeReport: The day it was sent cannot be before the entry was reported.
problem.referenceLong: The reference is too long (200 characters at most).

request.theirReferenceHint: The authority's protocol or case number.
request.textHint: In your words, or pasted from their letter.
request.onEntry: The request is filed on this entry and numbered from the company's series.
request.evidenceSub: From the style's technical file: the declaration, certificates, tests and production records the authority needs.
request.answerSub: What was sent to the authority, and when.
request.summaryHint: The documents and what they show.
request.noEvidenceYet: No evidence pack is named yet: say in the summary what was sent.
request.cancelSub: A request logged by mistake, or withdrawn by the authority.

problem.textLong: What they ask is too long (4,000 characters at most).
problem.receivedFuture: The day it came cannot be in the future.
problem.due: Choose the day to answer by.
problem.dueBeforeReceived: The deadline cannot be before the day it came.

recalls.title: Recalls and withdrawals
recalls.sub: Garments returned, remedied or disposed of, per recall.
recalls.none: No recall or withdrawal for this entry.
recalls.counts: Sent {sent} · returned {returned} · remedied {repaired} · disposed of {destroyed} · still out {out}
recalls.startTitle: Start a recall or withdrawal for {reference}
recalls.startSub: A draft is made from the entry's garments; you review the scope, block stock and tell customers before it starts.
recalls.startScope: The scope starts as the entry's own: its batches, serials, work orders and shipments of {style}.

log.title: Distributor information log
log.failed: The distributors could not be read
log.nobody: No customer received these garments: nobody to tell.
log.empty_one: {count} customer received these garments: draft their notice.
log.empty_other: {count} customers received these garments: draft their notices.
log.subject: Subject
log.failHint: Why it did not reach them (a new notice can be drafted after).
log.sendSub: Each recipient gets their own message in their language; a refused address holds only its own notice. A fresh code is asked.
log.sendFake: E-mails leave through the outbox; a phone call or portal message is recorded as made now.
log.allTold: Every distributor is told: the entry records the day.

holds.sub: Hold what is still here: work orders with garments not gone, garments by serial, shipments not left.
holds.dialogSub: Work orders {workOrders} · garments {serials} · shipments {shipments}: one hold per kind and site.
holds.reasonsFailed: The reasons could not be read: try again.

progress.afterStart: Rows appear when it starts: one per shipment that left with these garments.
progress.noRowsBody: No shipment left with these garments when it started.
progress.table: Returns, remedy and disposal per customer

public.sub: What consumers read first on the public DoC page of these garments: what is wrong, what to do, whom to contact.
public.live: Live on the public page since {date}
public.title: Title
public.problemHint: In plain words a rider understands.
public.actionHint: Stop using it, bring it back, how it is remedied.
public.contactHint: A phone number, an address or a site.
public.none: No words yet: add a language.
public.frozen: Published: these words do not change. A new language can still be added.
public.saveFirst: Save the words first: the notice is published as saved.
public.withdrawSub: It no longer shows on the public DoC page. It cannot be published again.

problem.missing: Every language needs a title, what is wrong, what to do and whom to contact.

scope.subDraft: What it calls back. The draft's scope can change until it starts.
scope.subStarted: It has started: the scope can only grow.
scope.wholeStyle: Every garment of {style} (batches cannot be told apart)
scope.codesHint: Separated by commas, spaces or new lines.
scope.widenHint: Only add: a started recall never narrows.
scope.alsoNamed: Also named by the entry — work orders: {workOrders}, shipments: {shipments}.

problem.nothing: Name what it calls back: the whole style, a batch or a serial.
problem.narrowed: A started recall only widens: keep what was there.

review.startSays_one: Starting records who started it and makes a row per shipment that left: {count} garment is concerned.
review.startSays_other: Starting records who started it and makes a row per shipment that left: {count} garments are concerned.

builder.reloadFailed: Could not read it again: this is the last copy.
builder.closeSub_one: How it ended. {count} garment is still out.
builder.closeSub_other: How it ended. {count} garments are still out.
builder.stillOut_one: {count} garment has not come back: say why in the note.
builder.stillOut_other: {count} garments have not come back: say why in the note.
builder.closeNoteHint: What came back, what was remedied, what could not be reached.
builder.cancelSub: A draft that will not start.

reach.STYLE: It concerns every garment of this model.
reach.BATCHES: It concerns these batches: {batches}. Check the batch number on your label.
reach.PART: It concerns some garments of batch {batch}: contact us to check yours.
reach.PART_SERIAL: It concerns some garments of batch {batch}: check the serial number on your label and contact us.
reach.PART_STYLE: It concerns some garments of this model: check the batch and serial on your label and contact us.

pdf.title: Notice to {authority} · {reference}
pdf.draft: Draft — to be submitted by a person
pdf.draftBody: Submit it on the authority's site (or as their channel asks), then mark it as sent on the entry with their reference.
pdf.cancelled: Cancelled: this notice was not sent.
pdf.failed: The notice could not be read
pdf.noAccessBody: You need compliance.register.view to see the register's notices. An administrator can give it.

dialog.conflict: Someone changed it meanwhile: read again. Check it and confirm once more.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.noticeSent: Type the code from your authenticator app to record that you sent this notice to the authority.
stepUp.distributorsSend: Type the code from your authenticator app to send these notices to the distributors.
stepUp.publish: Type the code from your authenticator app to publish the safety notice on the public page.

held.entryClosed: The entry is closed: it no longer changes.
held.referenceDone: The reference and the copy are recorded.
held.alreadySent: Sent already: it no longer changes.
held.riskNotDecided: A notice of risk needs the entry's risk decided as yes first.
held.noStyle: The request names no style: no technical file to build from.
held.evidenceNamed: An evidence pack is named already.
held.nothingToHold: Nothing left to hold: everything is gone or on hold already.
held.noGarments: The scope reaches no garment yet.
held.nobodyToDraft: Every customer has a notice drafted or sent.
held.notDraftNotice: Only a draft can be changed or cancelled.
held.notSentNotice: Only a sent notice gets an answer or fails.

done.evidenceAsked: Evidence pack asked for {number}: it is being built
done.recallDrafted: Draft made from the entry's garments: review each step, then start it.
done.published: Published: it is now first on the public DoC page

refused.noticeSent: The notice was not recorded as sent
refused.distributors: The distributors' notices were not saved
refused.public: The public notice was not saved

actions.failed: The recalls and the distributors could not be read
